analysis: Only a Swift test file changed: DistributedAutomaticBatchPlannerTests.swift. The visible base text shows planner fixtures built from constructed data. The patch adds an optional artifact parameter to fixture() so the registered artifact digest can be used, and adds tests, but the patch excerpt is truncated. The head-side additions near lines 745-788, 929-969 and 1083-1097 were not supplied as numbered text, so I could not examine them directly. The files touched are test-only; no production code, key handling, attestation, or coordinator/provider wire logic is modified in the supplied evidence. The base tests exercise cluster placement, link-probe history file permissions (0600), served-speed records keyed by worker build, and installed-plan handling. These are existing behaviors, and the test changes cannot weaken a production control. The temp directories are created with 0700 permissions. No threat-model assets (A-001..A-019) or trust boundaries (TB-002/003/007/011/012/013) are affected by test-only edits, and T-041 (prefix cache) is unrelated to the planner tests. Remaining uncertainty: the head-side additions were not visible, so any production change tied to these tests (for example ClusterPublicModels, the registered-artifact-digest path) lives in other units or batches and should be examined there for authorization and trust implications.
